name: strata-tokens-harbor
title: Strata tokens — Harbor
description: Every --strata-* variable for Harbor (light, dark, both densities). Import styles/strata-harbor.css once, at your app root.
docs: Import the tokens once at your app root, e.g. import './styles/strata-harbor.css' (Vite: src/main.tsx; Next: app/layout.tsx). Dark mode: <html data-strata-scheme="dark"> or <ThemeScope scheme="dark">. Fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Source+Code+Pro:wght@400;500&display=swap
